hints.tr: `pivot_table(index=..., columns=..., values=..., aggfunc=...)` — satır bir anahtar, sütun öteki.
hints.en: `pivot_table(index=..., columns=..., values=..., aggfunc=...)` — one key as rows, the other as columns.

hints.tr: Varsayılan hesap zaten ortalama, ama `aggfunc="mean"` yazmak daha açık.
hints.en: The default calculation is already the mean, but writing `aggfunc="mean"` is clearer.

hints.tr: Boş hücreleri saymak için `table.isna().sum().sum()` kullan; `int()` ile sayıya çevir.
hints.en: Use `table.isna().sum().sum()` to count the empty cells; wrap it in `int()`.

hints.tr:
Çözüm:

```python
table = data.pivot_table(
    index="city", columns="grade", values="score", aggfunc="mean"
)

print(table)
print(int(table.isna().sum().sum()))
print(table.loc["Ankara", "B"])
```
hints.en:
The solution:

```python
table = data.pivot_table(
    index="city", columns="grade", values="score", aggfunc="mean"
)

print(table)
print(int(table.isna().sum().sum()))
print(table.loc["Ankara", "B"])
```

hint.en: There is no `import pandas as pd` line.
